goodsServices.translation: 9 Semiconductors, semiconductor processors, chips for semiconductor processors, integrated circuits, chips for integrated circuits, circuit boards, microcomputers, microprocessor controls, microprocessors and computer peripherals, main memories and semiconductor material for the aforesaid goods; semiconductors for machines and machine devices; semiconductors for lighting, heating, steam generation, cooking, freezing, drying and ventilating apparatus; semiconductors for apparatus and instruments for clocks and time recording; semiconductors for musical instruments; semiconductors for games and toys; circuits for data conversion; computer firmware (software in read-only memory); apparatus and equipment for recording, reproducing and modifying sound, video and data; circuit cards for videos; sound circuit cards; circuit cards or circuit boards for audio and video (sound and image); video graphics accelerators (semiconductors); multimedia accelerators (semiconductors); video processors; computer programs; downloadable publications, namely program manuals and manuals; testing and calibration apparatus; devices for testing and programming integrated circuits and semiconductors and main memories; Computer software, namely application integration and connection software; computer utilities, computer programs for network management, computer software for accessing a global computer network and networked computer networks; computer operating systems; software for computer operating systems; programs for computer operating systems; computer software for enabling third party software applications. 16 Program manuals and manuals. 42 Licensing of technology; licensing of patents, trademarks, copyrights, trade secrets and/or knowledge in connection with the manufacture of semiconductors and their use; licensing of semiconductors; licensing of software in connection with the manufacture of semiconductors and their use; licensing of technology in connection with semiconductors and the manufacture of semiconductors; Licensing of technology related to and associated with semiconductor products, integrated circuits, circuit boards, microcomputers, microprocessor controls, microprocessors and computer peripherals, main memory and semiconductor material for the aforesaid goods, circuits for data conversion, computer firmware (software in read-only memory), electronic, electrical and electro-mechanical apparatus for use with computers, video circuit cards; Licensing of products for video systems, apparatus and equipment for recording, reproducing and modifying sound, video and data, computer programs; Licensing of product manuals and programming; Licensing of teaching materials relating to computers and data algorithms for compressing and decompressing data; Design of computer and telecommunications systems for commercial use; Consultancy services in the field of computers and related technologies for software design.
